days.title: Breitnau Heights and Upper Gorge
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Breitnau
stops.detail: The Ravenna stream drains the extensive high hollow located to the north around the village of Breitnau, within whose boundaries the approximately 4 km long, winding gorge is also located.

stops.name: Heimatpfad Hochschwarzwald
stops.detail: The High Black Forest Heritage Trail follows the gorge, partly via stairs and rock galleries.

stops.name: Ravennaschlucht
stops.detail: The Ravenna Gorge is located in the southern Black Forest.

stops.name: Großen Ravenna-Fall
stops.detail: Here the Ravenna forms several waterfalls, including the 16-meter-high Great Ravenna Fall at a crossing fault and the Little Ravenna Fall with a height of 6 meters.

stops.name: Ravennabrücke
stops.detail: The Höllental Railway crosses the exit of the gorge via the 37-meter-high Ravenna Bridge.

stops.name: Galgenbühl
stops.detail: Below the Ravenna Bridge, the Galgenbühl rises about 30 meters above the valley floor.
